card.title: Nintendo Switch CPU capacitors

claims.statement: Switch 'CPU capacitors'—one beside M92T36 and one beside the SOT-323-6 IC near MAX17050—are commonly associated with a dead CPU when shorted; check them before deeper work.

procedure: Check the two CPU capacitors for shorts before starting a repair.
card.caveats: Capacitor locations are shown only in images. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
